52880.commentary: (MNa) muṭṭhā sati etesan'ti muṭṭhassatī, naṭṭhassatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (SNa) muṭṭhassatino'ti naṭṭhassatino sativirahitā, idha kataṃ ettha pamussanti. (SNa) muṭṭhassatī'ti bhattanikkhittakāko viya naṭṭhassati, idha kataṃ ettha nassati.
